talking-in-varrock-talking-to-take-the-f.npc: Nilsal, adventurer. The name is Regulus Cento, one of the quetzal keepers for the Royal Family of Varlamore.
Well just look here to my dear companion, Primio, and you'll have your answer. Varlamore is a large and diverse kingdom, but thanks to our quetzals, navigating it is as straightforward as can be.
You're not wrong there. Nothing beats taking to the skies.

Speaking of which, Crown Prince Itzla Arkan has asked Primio and I to escort you to our capital city of Civitas illa Fortis, or Fortis as we prefer to call it. Is that something you'd be interested in?

Excellent! Now, I know Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you once we reach the capital, so he's sending the Tullus twins to greet you on arrival. I'll be sure to point them out to you once we're there.
So, ready for your first journey to Varlamore?

steps.npc: Kuani! We will depart at once.

steps.text: The screen fades to black, and the player arrives at Civitas illa Fortis.

steps.npc: Well, here we are! Welcome to Fortis!
I'm glad you think so! Now, I'm sure you're keen to get exploring, but Prince Itzla is very keen to meet with you first.

steps.player: You mentioned he'd be sending some people to meet with me?

steps.npc: Yes, the Tullus twins. That's them just to the west, by the stairs up to the palace. Why don't you head on over and introduce yourself?

options.text: There's something I need to do first.

steps.player: There's something I need to do first.

steps.npc: Very well. I will wait for you here.
